_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 52: 2-4 February 2026. Completes February 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats what the Lord showed them about the elections come November, that they will lose the Senate but barely maintain the House, and that if they do not start praying now they will lose the Senate.
mentions.quote: they'll lose the Senate, but they'll barely maintain the House
mentions.falsify_miss: Any other split. Fifth consistent telling.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has had it since the first part of December, that as he saw the number three going down the mountain he thought it had to do with skiers, and that he is still trying to figure out all the things the Lord was showing him.
mentions.quote: I thought it had to do with something with skiers
mentions.falsify_match: Something at the Winter Olympics involving the third.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. He is still working out what his own image means two months on, and says so.

mentions.claim_text: He says the state of the union is on the 24th or 25th of February in the House of Representatives and that this is a major time, and that going into the Olympics the 6th, which is Friday, would be the opening ceremony.
mentions.quote: on the 24th or 25th of February in the house of representatives
mentions.falsify_match: A State of the Union in that window.
mentions.falsify_miss: It falls elsewhere. Third date given for the same speech after the 25th and the 3rd, and the Olympic date is now right.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes that if they can get a lot of this darkness uncovered in that state and others so people realise how bad the government has been over the last four years and more since Joe Biden was in, it will really show.
mentions.quote: if we can get a lot of this darkness uncovered
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Marked as what he believes rather than what he saw.

mentions.claim_text: He says the fact checkers would go to another level concerning 2027 and 2028 and get even stronger, that he then saw a new Watergate scandal coming out of all this, and that this happened today concerning Europe though he is not exactly sure about it.
mentions.quote: I saw a new Watergate scandal coming out of all this
mentions.falsify_match: A major scandal arising from content moderation disputes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He hedges the same-day fulfilment himself with not exactly sure, which is worth crediting.

mentions.claim_text: He says they do not want the rest of it happening, that when he was shown that he thought it was what he saw in the vision, and asks whether it will keep unfolding or whether the body of Christ will intervene and pray because they do not want another one.
mentions.quote: will it keep unfolding or will the body of Christ intervene and pray
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the two options given are that it happens or that prayer stopped it.

mentions.claim_text: He asks where they are with the signs of the times of the coming of Christ and whether they have their head in the sand, says that if they think Jesus is coming back later rather than sooner they are missing it, and that right now they have an opportunity for a major revival.
mentions.quote: If you are thinking that Jesus is coming back later than sooner, you're missing it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it sits against his own pushback on 2026 and 2028 dates in the same season.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of not having the right red wave in November and having an impeachment in 2027 or 2028 as one of the timeframes because of losing the Senate and the House, says there is a lot here and a lot to lose, and that the church needs to wake up.
mentions.quote: having an impeachment in 2027 2028 because of losing the Senate and the House
mentions.falsify_match: Impeachment proceedings in 2027 or 2028 following midterm losses.
mentions.falsify_miss: No proceedings. Note this version has both chambers lost, where the settled telling has the House held.

mentions.claim_text: They locate the original recording, note the first one was around April and this one is July, he says he played this and credits his son for finding it, and the clip has escalating war and him wanting peace.
mentions.quote: the original one was around April. This is July. Good job, son
mentions.falsify_match: Another on-air replay of an original recording, with the dates located from the archive rather than from memory.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip does not say what he says it says.

mentions.claim_text: He reports bringing them home as fulfilling what he said he would do, that this is what they will see over 2026, 2027 and 2028 as a great migration starts to take place, and tells them to sow into the migration because not all can afford it.
mentions.quote: A great migration will start to take place. Sew into the migration
mentions.falsify_match: A large observable movement of people, most likely aliyah given the bringing them home language.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement. The claim comes with a request for money attached, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He asks how many minutes he has and says he is trying not to talk too long, wonders where they will be in 2027 and 2028 and says that is the timeframe, and mentions seeing the plague again and people talking about it.
mentions.quote: where will we be in 2027 2028? That's the time frame
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Seventh restatement of the plague timing.

mentions.claim_text: He says something major is going to happen because he sees it so many times over and over and the Lord keeps warning him to tell them, and that he saw it started in January and started to be on the news a little bit in November.
mentions.quote: the Lord keeps warning me to tell you all that something major
mentions.time_phrase: started January, on the news in November
mentions.falsify_match: A major event traceable to a January start.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Something major is the widest possible content, and the repetition is offered as the evidence for it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he went off into another realm that day, that he does not remember what was said behind the pulpit because God was talking to him so loudly while he sat there, and that he cannot even remember who was sitting beside him.
mentions.quote: I went off in another realm today. I don't even remember what was said
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an account of how the material arrives, and of losing track of the room while it does.

mentions.claim_text: He asks who is going to come and says he wants it to look its best when they show up, tells them to have integrity and excellence in everything including mowing grass and pulling weeds, and says cleanliness is godliness.
mentions.quote: Even mowing grass, pulling weeds, have excellence in doing it

mentions.claim_text: He declares that the man will not make it to the White House and will not run for president, that he will have to go and sell ice cream, and thanks God that he will not slither his belly to the White House, adding that the nation will have one more.
mentions.quote: He'll not make it to the White House. He'll not run for president
mentions.falsify_match: The man does not run in 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: He runs, and more so if he wins. A flat negative call, which is rare, though it is framed as a declaration rather than a sight.
